segments.text: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central has powerful built-in capabilities to analyze and report on data, but finding the insights you need takes time.

Copilot simplifies analysis by transforming raw data into insightful summaries using next-generation AI. Just describe what you need, and Copilot creates totals, pivots, and filters to help you find the information you're looking for.
Now, you can easily explore trends and outliers without ever leaving Business Central. And it's available for most Business Central data, even your customizations,
so everyone in your organization can get to insights faster. Make data-driven decisions that propel your business forward with Copilot in Business Central.
